path-of-the-elements.summary: A barbarian whose Rage calls up fire, frost and lightning to hurl at foes.

Raging Elements.summary: As you Rage (and later with a Bonus Action while raging), use one elemental option; each rolls a number of dice equal to your Rage Damage bonus, save DC 8 + PB + CON.

options.name: Icefury
options.summary: Melee or ranged spell attack (CON) at a creature within 30 ft for Rage-bonus d8s Cold; if hit, its next Fire damage before your next turn ends adds 1d10 Fire.

options.name: Lava Burst
options.summary: A creature you see within 30 ft makes a DEX save: Rage-bonus d4s Fire, half on a success; on a fail its next Lightning damage before your next turn ends adds 1d8 Lightning.

options.name: Lightning Bolt
options.summary: A creature you see within 30 ft makes a DEX save: Rage-bonus d6s Lightning, half on a success; on a fail its next Cold damage before your next turn ends adds 1d6 Cold.

Echo of the Elements.summary: Learn Elementalism. Daylight, Water Walk and Wind Wall each cost one Rage use to cast instead of a slot; WIS is the casting ability.

Primordial Bond.summary: Resistance to Cold, Fire and Lightning while raging.

Elemental Overload.summary: Raging Elements gain riders, hit or miss: Icefury makes the target lower its next damage roll by half your roll; Lava Burst sets the target and enemies within 10 ft burning; Lightning Bolt arcs to a second target within 30 ft (DEX save, same damage, half on success).

options.name: Icefury
options.summary: Hit or miss, the target takes half your roll (rounded down) off its next damage roll before your next turn starts.

options.name: Lava Burst
options.summary: Pass or fail, the target and each enemy within 10 ft of it start burning.

options.name: Lightning Bolt
options.summary: Pass or fail, lightning jumps to another creature you see within 30 ft of the first, which makes a DEX save for the same total, half on a success.

path-of-the-spiritual-guardian.summary: A barbarian whose Rage calls spirits of beasts, ancestors or the elements to fight and shield beside them.

Spiritual Protectors.summary: While raging, a creature you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike suffers your choice of spirit effect: Distract, Hinder or Strike.

options.name: Distract
options.summary: Until your next turn starts, it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you or another barbarian with this feature.

options.name: Hinder
options.summary: Apply the Slow mastery on top of the weapon's other mastery property.

options.name: Strike
options.summary: It takes an extra 1d4 Cold, Fire or Lightning damage (your pick).

Spirit Shield.summary: Reaction while raging: when a creature you see within 30 ft takes damage, cut it by a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

Consult the Spirits.summary: Cast Augury or Clairvoyance with no slot or Material components (Clairvoyance sends an invisible guardian spirit as its sensor); WIS casting; once per Short or Long Rest.

Spirits’ Fury.summary: Rolling 18-20 on a melee weapon attack during the Attack action grants one more attack roll with that weapon in the same action; once per turn.
